docs.title: Skills
docs.text:
• GIS & Remote Sensing

    • QGIS, ArcGIS Pro, Google Earth Engine
    • GDAL / OGR, GRASS GIS
    • Multispectral and SAR image analysis
    • Cloud Native Geospatial (COG, STAC, Zarr)

  • Programming

    • Python — GeoPandas, NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib
    • R — sf, terra, ggplot2
    • JavaScript — Leaflet, MapLibre GL
    • SQL, PostgreSQL + PostGIS

  • Machine Learning & GeoAI

    • Supervised classification — Random Forest, XGBoost
    • Deep learning for image segmentation — U-Net, SAM
    • scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow
    • Object detection in satellite imagery

  • Web Mapping & Data

    • Leaflet.js, Folium, MapLibre GL JS
    • Cloud storage — AWS S3, Google Cloud Storage
    • Data formats — GeoTIFF, GeoParquet, NetCDF
    • Streamlit for data-driven web apps

  • Data & Cloud

    • PostgreSQL + PostGIS
    • Cloud storage: AWS S3, Google Cloud Storage
    • Data formats: GeoJSON, GeoTIFF, NetCDF, Zarr, GeoParquet

  • Drone / UAV Data Processing

    • Mission planning and flight operations
    • Photogrammetry: Agisoft Metashape, OpenDroneMap
    • Point cloud processing: CloudCompare, PDAL

docs.title: QGIS Resources
docs.text: A short list of QGIS resources and data sources I find useful.

docs.title: Learning & Documentation
docs.text:
• QGIS.org — The official QGIS website: downloads, news, and community info.
  • QGIS Documentation — Official user manual, training manual, and PyQGIS developer cookbook.
  • QGIS Training Manual — A free, structured course that takes you from the basics to advanced analysis.
  • QGIS Tutorials and Tips — Step-by-step tutorials with sample data.
  • Free and Open Source GIS Ramblings — Anita Graser's blog on QGIS, movement data, and spatial analysis.

docs.title: Community & Plugins
docs.text:
• QGIS Plugin Repository — Browse and download community plugins.
  • GIS Stack Exchange — Q&A forum for troubleshooting QGIS and wider GIS problems.

docs.title: Data Sources
docs.text:
• Natural Earth — Free public-domain vector and raster map data for cartography.
  • Geofabrik Downloads — Regularly updated OpenStreetMap extracts by country and region.
  • Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem — Free Sentinel satellite imagery and Earth observation data.
